en.q: How long does it take to build a custom software system in Malaysia?
en.a: Most MVPs take 6–12 weeks. Full enterprise systems (ERP, HRMS, loan management) typically range from 3 to 6 months depending on scope, integrations, and compliance requirements. Trion Creation gives you a clear timeline during the free consultation.

en.q: Does Trion Creation build both mobile apps and web systems?
en.a: Yes. We deliver native iOS/Android apps, progressive web apps, admin dashboards, backend APIs and cloud infrastructure — typically as one fully integrated stack so your mobile, web and backend all speak the same language.

en.q: Can Trion Creation customise or migrate from an existing system?
en.a: Absolutely. We regularly customise Odoo, WordPress, Laravel and legacy PHP systems, and handle full data migration, re-platforming and feature extension without downtime.

en.q: How much does a custom software project cost in Malaysia?
en.a: Pricing depends on scope, but typical project bands are RM15k–40k for MVPs, RM40k–150k for mid-size business systems, and RM150k+ for enterprise platforms. We provide a fixed-scope quote after the first discovery call — no hidden costs.

en.q: Does Trion Creation provide support and maintenance after launch?
en.a: Yes. All projects include a warranty period, and we offer monthly support retainers covering bug fixes, security patches, server monitoring, feature updates and 24/7 critical incident response.

en.q: Who owns the source code after the project is delivered?
en.a: You do. Clients own 100% of the source code and data. We sign NDAs, follow secure SDLC practices, and can deploy to your own AWS, Alibaba Cloud or on-premise infrastructure if preferred.

en.q: What industries has Trion Creation built software for?
en.a: Trion Creation has delivered 150+ projects across social media (Yippi, 5M+ users), finance and lending (MyCashOut), Web3 (Colorverse), logistics and transport (DDDrive), legal (ThaiAdvocates), HR, retail and F&B POS, theme park imaging (Pictureworks) and online education (ReSkills).

en.q: What technologies does Trion Creation use?
en.a: Frontend: React, Next.js, Vue.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS. Backend: Node.js, Laravel, PHP, Express, GraphQL. Mobile: Flutter, React Native, Swift, Kotlin. Database: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase, Prisma. Cloud: AWS, Alibaba Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes. AI/ML: TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenAI. Blockchain: Solidity, Ethereum, Web3.js. ERP: Odoo, custom ERP.
